keyword_setup.dimension_selection: The parser recognizes DEFORM-2D in a header comment, sets primary dimension to 2 and the linked root to 3.
keyword_setup.coordinate_rows: RZ header supplies object ID and count; each row has label, x and y.
keyword_setup.connectivity_rows: ELMCON header supplies object ID and element count; each row has label and four node slots. A triangle repeats its first node in the fourth slot.

algorithm: Generate directed successive edges in element and slot order, including fourth-to-first except when first and fourth node IDs coincide.
For each non-cleared edge, find the first later reversed edge. Clear that edge's first node and omit the current edge. Same-direction edges do not cancel.
Compact survivors in place without sorting.
Start a chain at each still-unused surviving edge in order. Append its starting node, then consume edges and append their endpoints.

Search each next link from the outer starting-edge index plus one. Choose the first unused edge whose start equals the current endpoint. This can revisit earlier positions relative to the previously selected edge.
Record inclusive one-based start/end ranges in the node stream. Append zero after each chain, then replace the final zero with -1.
When no boundary survives, ranges is empty and the node stream is [-1].

object_consumer.copy: Node slices described by the raw ranges, excluding separators.
object_consumer.total_at_object_0x88c: Sum of each copied group node count minus one.
object_consumer.qualification: The raw builder component returns all ranges. The original consumer's 100-group clamp is statically recovered but not exercised by these fixtures.

verification.qualification: Cases were independently prepared by another agent in this project; this is not an externally certified or exhaustive evaluation.

limitations: Nonpositive IDs and excessive sizes are rejected outside the implemented compatibility domain.
Allocation failure, malformed chains and large object-group truncation remain untested.
Observed chains are retained in original order; the implementation does not impose a geometric canonicalization or infer closedness.
Full object lifecycle, dependent-state integration and keyword import are not implemented by this component.
